prompt:
Use case: design-mockup. Create one polished Worklive Screen Landscape concept image, wide landscape, approximately 2:1. Reference image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE only. Preserve its pale mist-blue mountain horizon, quiet porcelain plane, extremely thin floating screens, refined large editorial serif titles and readable sans-serif UI, generous light and soft ambient shadows. This is a different screen: opening a persistent CASE, a context capsule containing one goal's work across sessions. Make a visually distinctive spatial UI, not a dashboard or ordinary desktop app.

Composition: one large warm-white floating document folio dominates the center-right foreground, mostly face-on and legible. Its lower edge has a beautiful thin neutral ceramic folder-tab grip. Behind the main surface, 4 very shallow offset paper/display leaves with delicate top tabs visually imply all the retained case material. Neutral grey edge for the case, no provider-colored ownership outline. TWO small agent display planes remain in the upper-left background: Ada / Codex with teal #2D9D8F edge, Lena / Claude Code with terracotta #D97757 edge. Ada shows a small browser research preview with status "Ready for review", and a small clickable folder tab beneath it reading "Onboarding research". Lena shows a simple L monogram and "Idle". Never suggest either is currently executing. Agents retain provider colored ceramic name grips. There are no 3D characters or physical monitor stands.

On foreground folio:
Small breadcrumb "Website launch / Case 024"
Large title "Onboarding research"
One line description "Find a clearer first experience for new users."
Small outlined status badge "Ready for review"
Thin tab line "Overview    Files 4    Sources 6    Conversation    History"
Overview is selected.
Below, a generous editorial layout of only two clear regions:
Left region heading "What we have" with three horizontal small paper thumbnails and exact labels: "Research brief", "Findings v2", "Source notes".
Below them a subtle paperclip row "Attached context · product-brief.pdf".
Right region heading "Decisions & activity" with 3 short, easily readable timestamped entries:
"09:10 · You — Focus on first-time users"
"09:24 · Ada — Saved six sources"
"09:42 · Ada — Findings v2 is ready"
Beneath the content, a quiet next-action strip "Next: review the findings" with a single button "Open findings".
At bottom edge of case a faint line "4 files · 6 sources · 18 messages · 2 runs". Treat numbers as illustrative.
Neutral ceramic grip reads "Case 024 · Onboarding research". A small export icon and "Export case" appears in a corner. No Accept button on the summary: explicit review happens inside the findings.

At lower left outside the folio, three closed elegant thin folder capsules in a short receding shelf, named "Onboarding research", "Launch copy", "Competitor notes". They represent selectable saved cases, not agent-owned memory. Top left of entire canvas "WORKLIVE", title "Your cases"; small toggle "Agents | Cases" with Cases selected. Minimal global navigation pill bottom center "Overview   Inbox   Projects   Library   Menu". Small footer "Screen Landscape · Case concept".

Prioritize the readable foreground content and spatial folio metaphor. Use restrained accent color only for provider identities. No dark theme, no dense card grid, no large sidebar, no neon, no science fiction holograms, no decorative connectors. This is a static design study, not an actual application screenshot. Do not add extra panels, extra providers, fabricated claims of live activity, or technical infrastructure labels.
note: Static illustrative design; no application implementation or performance validation.
